question:
**In the following question, a statement has been given with highlighted text. Select the options that can replace the text with the correct idiom or phrase**

The coach felt **extremely nervous** on seeing the team performing poorly in the first quarter.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Heart skipped a beat**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The idiom "Heart skipped a beat" is used to say that someone is suddenly very surprised, excited, or nervous about something. (कोई अचानक किसी बात को लेकर बहुत हैरान, उत्साहित या घबराया हुआ है)

 
 
• Example - *The shocking news made her heart skip a beat.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the given idiom "Heart skipped a beat" means "extremely nervous"

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Like a cakewalk**" means that something is very easy to do or achieve. (यह करना या हासिल करना बहुत आसान है)
 
• "**Crying Wolf**" means not be believed because of previous false warnings. (पिछली झूठी चेतावनियों के कारण विश्वास नहीं किया गया)
 
• "**Raining cats and dogs**" means to rain very heavily. (बहुत भारी बारिश होना)
